symmetry: one representative per stage; left/right copies assumed identical
rotorSource: Phase-3 preliminary row geometry; not CAD or measured mass properties

shaft.basis: assumed output shaft/support span; FA4119 rotor/output shaft geometry not specified by decision record

equivalentFanDisk.materialApproximation: steel annulus used as a lumped mass/inertia proxy for hub, blades and attachments; carbon blades are not modeled anisotropically

bearings.basis: assumed support values for screening only; selected fan-shaft bearings not specified

declaredForcingFamilies: rotor blade passing order from Phase-3 blade count
stator passing order from Phase-3 vane count
7x electrical fundamental order from FA4119 14-pole motor
20 kHz and 40 kHz fixed PWM lines from controller design range
unresolvedForcingData: gear tooth count and mesh frequency
selected bearing rolling-element geometry and characteristic frequencies
measured shaft, hub, rotor, and blade masses/inertias

gcpPlan.billingNote: One reusable ephemeral Spot VM; 20-minute max lifetime. Conservative estimate uses $0.10/h reference rate ($0.034 VM), with $0.005 storage/I/O allowance and rounded total $0.04. Target <=$0.10 and hard cap $0.12; actual regional billing must be checked from the GCP receipt.

evidenceClass: application-specific assumed ROSS model; requires measured/CAD support data before design acceptance
